Regiō VII · Lītus is an ORDINARY FABULAE DUEL region, so every number
below mirrors the r06 block in rules.php rather than r05's: the boss is
Vulpēs Callida, NOT the wolf (CURRICULUM §1 gives Lupus R1, R5, R9 and
the R12 finale), so she gets the standard hp 6 / 70 phase-seconds
budget — 22 caterva + 28 clamor + 20 fuga — and the standard rewards.
bossMinMs 15000 is the floor every duel region uses (region1, r02-r06).
The phase seconds are CEILINGS, not durations, so three clean phases at
a few seconds each is a fast child and not a forgery — the reasoning
rules.php already records against 'region1'.
XP mirrors the fabulae track exactly: step 20 is the global default
(RULE_DEFAULT_STEP_XP) and is listed here only so the value is visible;
fight 30 and quizEach 10 with quizPassMaxWrong 1 are what r01-r06 use.
quizKey carries the same {q, a} pair per row that r03-r06 and l3 use:
rules.php stores the question word and the vocab key that must be
picked, so grading never depends on the order the client drew the
options in. For a word -> pick-the-image quiz the answer IS the question
word, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/fabulae-r07.js.
